correctness.rationale: For odd prime power N=q^k, Fourier multipliers equal 1/9 times a nine-term roots-of-unity sum F_u(ζ_N). Cyclotomic divisibility and Φ_(q^k)(1)=q force q|9, hence only q=3 can be singular. At N=3m, Φ=1+X^m+X^(2m) makes all residue-fiber coefficients equal. The fiber containing 0 gives a=1,b=3 (32 type A) or a=0,b=1. In the latter all remaining three coordinates must form the three distinct positions of one nonzero lifted fiber after sign changes, giving 192(m−1) type B; case k=1 is covered by m=1. This exhausts all vanishing characters and yields exact nullity, not an estimate from the N=3,9,27 finite scans.
